task1.title: The Process of Recycling Paper
task1.prompt: You recently learned about the process of recycling paper at a local workshop. Write a letter to a friend explaining how paper is recycled. In your letter, include the following points: 1) Describe the steps involved in recycling paper. 2) Explain the importance of recycling for the environment. 3) Share how your friend can contribute to recycling efforts in their own community. Your letter should be at least 150 words long.

task2.title: The Impact of Technology on Social Interaction
task2.prompt: In recent years, technology has become an integral part of our daily lives, affecting how we communicate and interact with others. Some people argue that technology has a negative impact on social interaction, while others believe it has enhanced our ability to connect with one another. Discuss both views and give your opinion. You should support your answer with relevant examples and reasons. Your essay should be at least 250 words long.
